sources.title: Un Ministral, des Ministraux
sources.evidence: Contemporaneous October 16, 2024 announcement introduces Ministral 3B and 8B and says they are available starting today. It releases the 8B Instruct weights under the Mistral Research License, offers a separate commercial license, and describes 128k context, interleaved sliding-window attention and function calling.

sources.title: Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 model card at revision 2f494a194c5b980dfb9772cb92d26cbb671fce5a
sources.evidence: Exact original instruction checkpoint: dense Transformer, 8,019,808,256 parameters, 36 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, 4096 hidden width, 12288 intermediate width and 131072 vocabulary. It specifies 128k trained context, ragged full/local attention, MRL, function calling and native inference examples. Its older vLLM section documents a framework-specific 32k limitation.

sources.title: Ministral 8B legacy model reference
sources.evidence: The exact ministral-8b-2410 reference links the original Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 weights. Its Weights table explicitly lists Parameters (B)=8 and Active (B)=8, MRL and 128k context. The retrospective page instead dates release to October 9, 2024.

sources.title: Ministral 8B model reference, Markdown
sources.evidence: Exact API name ministral-8b-2410, text input/output, 128k context, function calling, MRL and original checkpoint link. It lists December 31, 2025 API retirement and a distinct Ministral 3 8B replacement; these are not the original checkpoint specifications.

sources.title: Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: MistralForCausalLM dense BF16 model with 36 layers, 4096 hidden size, 12288 intermediate size, 32 query/8 KV heads and untied 131072-token embeddings. Layer types repeat one full-attention layer and three sliding-attention layers. This interoperability configuration sets both maximum positions and local window to 32768.

sources.title: Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 native inference parameters
sources.evidence: Exact native checkpoint parameters specify max_position_embeddings=131072 and sliding_window=[null,32768,32768,32768], establishing full 128k capacity with interleaved 32k local windows.

sources.title: Mistral AI Research License 0.1
sources.evidence: Research license restricts models, derivatives and outputs to defined research purposes; commercial activities require a separate license. It is not Apache 2.0 or an unrestricted open-source license.

sources.title: Mistral API changelog
sources.evidence: The retrospective 2024 changelog places the original ministral-3b-2410 and ministral-8b-2410 release under October 9, conflicting with the contemporaneous October 16 announcement.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Repository is public and ungated at revision 2f494a194c5b980dfb9772cb92d26cbb671fce5a. It lists the model card, configuration, native parameters, four BF16 Transformers weight shards and consolidated native weights.

sources.title: Original checkpoint weight shard, bounded public access probe
sources.evidence: An unauthenticated Range bytes=0-7 request returned HTTP 206 and Content-Range bytes 0-7/4983007904. Only eight bytes were read, confirming public access to actual weights without downloading the shard.

sources.title: Ragged attention supported in vLLM
sources.evidence: A November 23, 2024 discussion by organization member Patrick von Platen describes removal of the maximum-sequence-length workaround following vLLM ragged-attention support. Therefore the model card's 32k framework limitation must not be generalized to all current implementations.

name.note: Normalized display name of the exact original October 2024 instruction checkpoint, retaining its revision.

developer.note: Released by Mistral AI in its own announcement and model repository.

family.note: Original Ministral family introduced alongside the 3B sibling; not the December 2025 Ministral 3 family.

release_date.note: Retain the contemporaneous public launch date: the October 16 announcement says available starting today and releases 8B Instruct weights. Retrospective docs and changelog instead say October 9. No contemporaneous evidence establishing public availability on October 9 was found; preserve this conflict rather than silently replacing the launch date.

open_weights.note: Developer released the exact checkpoint; current metadata is public/ungated and a bounded unauthenticated weight request succeeded. Public weights do not imply unrestricted commercial use.

license.note: Public original 8B Instruct weights use MRL 0.1, with research-use restrictions. Commercial deployment has a separate Mistral commercial license; do not substitute Apache 2.0 from successors or conflate public access with permissive licensing.

parameters_b.note: Exact 8,019,808,256 count is disclosed in the developer architecture table. It is corroborated by 36 dense layers and untied embeddings from the configuration; this is a full checkpoint count, not nominal 8B or a packed-storage count.

active_parameters_b.note: The exact legacy model reference explicitly lists Active (B)=8 for the original linked checkpoint. This is a nominal rounded disclosure, not an inference that a dense model's exact active count equals its total 8.019808256B.

architecture.note: Developer explicitly calls it a dense Transformer. It uses grouped-query attention and a repeating pattern of one full-context attention layer followed by three 32768-token sliding-window layers; no MoE claim is needed.

context_window.note: Native parameters explicitly set 131072 maximum positions and the card specifies trained 128k context. Transformers config instead contains 32768, and the card documents an older vLLM interleaved-attention limitation. Retain native model capacity while recording this implementation discrepancy; later maintainer discussion reports vLLM support.

modalities.note: Exact legacy API reference explicitly labels text input and output, consistent with the original text-only causal-language-model configuration. Do not transfer vision capability from the later Ministral 3 family.

reasoning.note: No exact first-party statement establishing or denying a dedicated native thinking/reasoning mode was found in the original model card, current exact model reference, configuration or targeted searches. Ordinary reasoning benchmarks and a standard instruction template do not prove such a mode or its absence; clear the unsupported baseline false.

tool_call.note: Explicit function-calling support in the announcement, exact model card and API reference; the card includes a native structured tool-call example.

description.value: Instruction-tuned text model with interleaved sliding-window attention and native function calling.
description.note: Replace subjective efficiency wording and ambiguous open-model wording with directly documented capabilities.

patch.name: Ministral 8B Instruct 2410
patch.description: Instruction-tuned text model with interleaved sliding-window attention and native function calling.
patch.notes: Original October 2024 instruction checkpoint; distinct from Ministral 3 8B released in December 2025. Contemporaneous Mistral announcement dated October 16, 2024 says available starting today. Retrospective model documentation and API changelog instead give October 9; the public launch date is retained with this conflict recorded. Exact total count: 8,019,808,256 parameters. The official legacy Weights table separately discloses a rounded 8B active count; it is not an exact active-count derivation. Public weights use Mistral Research License 0.1 with research-use restrictions. Commercial use requires a separate license. Native maximum context is 131072 tokens with attention pattern full/32768/32768/32768. The Transformers configuration sets 32768 maximum positions; the card describes an older framework limitation, while a later maintainer discussion reports vLLM ragged-attention support. Dedicated native reasoning/thinking support could not be verified; ordinary reasoning ability does not establish a separate reasoning mode. The legacy API reference lists retirement on December 31, 2025. This does not remove the original public checkpoint or establish that any historical API endpoint currently operates.

sources.label: Original checkpoint weight shard, bounded public access probe

summary: Verified the exact original 2410 checkpoint across all 14 fields. Correct total parameters to the explicitly disclosed 8.019808256B, record the separately published nominal 8B active count, dense architecture and revision-qualified name, and replace unsupported description wording. Confirm public MRL-restricted weights, native 131072 context, text modalities and function calling. Retain October 16 public launch while documenting the retrospective October 9 conflict. Clear unsupported reasoning=false to null; native thinking status remains unverified.
